correctness.rationale: Euler additivity gives the exact/Frobenius subgroup cut; the stable Ext formula proves ideal orthogonality; Euler-zero stabilizers give complete ideal approximations; long exact cohomology yields exact quotient-valued object obstructions; and the connecting-map identity gives the sharp total-Betti modulus threshold.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The H=2Z parity construction is prior work; targeted searches found no arbitrary-subgroup family, Z/H obstruction pair, all-residue realization, or classification of total-Betti extension closure by modulus.

value.rationale: The result isolates Euler additivity as the general mechanism, proves that parity is uniquely compatible with total-Betti divisibility, and gives exact objectwise obstruction invariants across the whole subgroup family.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
